description: This file contains tests for the extension map in a Python project, specifically verifying the existence and correctness of certain package files, directories, and version consistency between files.

classes.name: PyProjectTOML
classes.description: Class used to parse and access data from the pyproject.toml configuration file.

methods.name: Dict[str,Version] create_ext_map(extensions: dict)
methods.description: Creates a mapping of extension names to their parsed Version objects based on provided extension data.

methods.name: Dict[str,VersionConstraint] load_req_ext(file: Path)
methods.description: Loads and processes the required extension dependencies from a pyproject.toml file.

methods.name: test_extension_map()
methods.description: Test function that verifies directory structure, presence of init files, absence of static assets, and version consistency for the package.
